title: 可调 HDA 与嵌入式算法交付
summary: 从 Hair Tangent Baker 成功案例提炼：参数化算法、原始输入保护、默认兼容、显式烘焙与版本验收。单项目候选方法，尚未独立执行或跨项目验证。

use_when: Delivering a reusable artist-facing HDA with parameterized algorithms and optional explicit bake/export commands
avoid_when: A bounded scene edit does not need an HDA
Treating this hair-specific algorithm as a general mesh/texture solution

inputs: Declared geometry/texture contracts and target Houdini version
Artist control requirements and acceptance criteria
Existing instance values and definition version when upgrading
stages: Assess target-version native nodes and reasonable combinations; distinguish a native algorithm gap from a missing MCP wrapper and record the implementation rationale
Choose native nodes, VEX or embedded Python by product needs and maintainability
Expose semantic controls and neutral defaults
Separate preserved input, working geometry and preview
Implement explicit bake/export with validation, staged unique outputs and cancellation
Test default equivalence and parameter behavior
Test actual delivered definition and fresh reopen
Record version-specific outcomes and engine acceptance separately
outputs: Version-scoped acceptance reports and completed batch manifests
acceptance: Neutral controls preserve the baseline within the declared exact/tolerance contract
Artist parameters affect their intended output
Original-input preservation and mode-specific UV/topology contracts pass
Ordinary evaluation does not implicitly publish bake/export files
Delivered modules match intended sources and fresh instantiation/reopen passes
Independent target-engine check when the task requires it
rollback: Preserve versioned asset and HIP backups before authorized writes
Use Undo for supported scene changes; restore definitions/files separately
Discard only the failed staging batch; retain published valid outputs
